recipes.name: gitlab-my-mrs-watch

recipes.description: Auto-monitor every open MR you authored across all GitLab projects via Todos API. No per-MR setup.

recipes.name: mantis-bug-watch
recipes.description: Watch Mantis filter with source + keyword + resolution=open filters.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: mantis-bug-fix-batch
recipes.display_name: Mantis — fix many bugs by id list

recipes.description: Filter watch for my open MRs → mr-review-fix when comments change.

pipelines.name: mr-review-fix
pipelines.description: Triage: act/skip/close/noop. noop = silent exit when latest comment is Forge or this Job user — breaks self-reply loop.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: mantis-bug-fix-and-mr
pipelines.description: Mantis bug → fetch-all (incl. notes + history) → triage (ACT/SKIP semantic check) → fix-code → MR → resolution=fixed → bugnote (ref:autofix-<id>).
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: mr-pre-review
pipelines.description: Analyze + post pre-review comment + open Forge chat session.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: issue-fix-and-review
pipelines.description: Fetch GitHub issue → Claude proposes fix → push + open PR → AI review.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: multi-agent-collaboration
pipelines.description: Two-agent conversation: architect designs, implementer codes. Demo template.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: review-mr
pipelines.description: GitHub PR auto-review: fetch diff → analyze → post review comment via gh.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet Mantis bug → fix → MR pipeline. User provides a bug id + base branch; pipeline fetches Mantis context, has Claude propose a minimal fix per user_prompt focus, opens a GitLab MR via glab, notifies assignee + reporter on Teams. Copy of mantis-bug-fix-and-mr with user_prompt and baked-in defaults for MR/Teams templates.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mr-pre-review
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet GitLab MR pre-review. User provides an MR URL; pipeline fetches MR meta + diff + discussion, runs Claude analysis per user_prompt focus, posts a '🤖 Forge pre-review:' comment, and opens a Forge chat session for the human reviewer to drill into. Copy of mr-pre-review simplified for manual single runs.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mr-review
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet GitLab MR review responder. User provides an MR URL; pipeline reads all comments + diff, triages (act/skip/close/noop) per user_prompt policy, optionally pushes a fixup commit, replies on the MR, and notifies Teams. Copy of mr-review-fix simplified for manual single runs.
pipelines.author: forge
